name: tech-campus
description: TechCampus — devenir data engineer ou ingénieur cloud/DevOps en partant de zéro

scripts.content:check: rolldown scripts/check-exercises.ts --platform node --format esm -o .tmp/check.mjs --external pyodide --external sql.js --log-level warn && node .tmp/check.mjs
scripts.test:engines: rolldown tests/shell.test.ts --platform node --format esm -o .tmp/shell.mjs --log-level warn && node .tmp/shell.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/copy-pyodide.mjs && npm run content && npm run content:check && npm run test:engines && tsc --noEmit && vite build
